title: sim: add display-chord STEP and STL loader for visual machine part bodies

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
Add a display-chord STEP and STL loader for user-supplied machine part bodies so CamCraft can show real vendor CAD meshes safely.

## Context
Machining-grade STEP import (`crates/kernel/src/solidcore_step_import.rs` and `crates/app/src/geometry/import/step.rs`) meshes at 0.005 mm chord and refuses a file when one solid fails healing or contains open cosmetic shells (`SHELL_BASED_SURFACE_MODEL`). Vendor machine STEP files commonly include sheet-metal enclosures and logos that fail machining-grade checks and produce millions of triangles at 0.005 mm chord.

## Scope
- Add a display-only mesh loader in `camcraft-sim` (using `camcraft-geometry::step` and the pure STL reader moved by `#3639`) that meshes STEP part files at a coarse display chord (default 1.0 mm, configurable within safe bounds) and enforces a per-machine facet budget (for example 100_000 to 150_000 triangles).
- Accept open cosmetic surface shells (`SHELL_BASED_SURFACE_MODEL`) and skip unbuildable cosmetic sub-solids with named diagnostics when loading visual-only machine bodies.
- Add a `BodySource` tag for visual-only bodies so machine-part collision checks report `not judged` for any open or uncertified body and never claim a collision check passed on visual-only geometry.
- Refuse corrupt, non-finite, or oversized files (over `MAX_STEP_BYTES` or facet caps) cleanly by name with no panic.

## Done means
Unit tests load a closed STEP part and an open-shell visual STEP or STL part within the display triangle budget, refuse corrupt or oversized inputs by name, and verify that collision checks report `not judged` for visual-only bodies.

Depends on #2591 and #3639.

Part of #3239
